_comment: FX-LOG-01: process_logs routing + safe_decode_body + sink column lists. safe_decode_body vectors EXECUTED against the verbatim body (probe /tmp/fx_webhooks_probe.py). Rest transcribed from bgtasks/logger_task.py:22-100. APIActivityLog columns from db/models/api.py:97-126.

log_to_mongo.no_collection: get_mongo_collection() None -> logger.error('MongoDB not configured') + False (note: error, while get_mongo_collection itself logs info)

mongo.collection: api_activity_logs (vs 'webhook_logs' for save_webhook_log — different collection, same connection class)
get_mongo_collection: not MongoConnection.is_configured() -> logger.info('MongoDB not configured') + None

process_logs.no_return: returns None on both paths; per-log errors swallowed inside the sink (False discarded)
process_logs.routing: if MongoConnection.is_configured(): log_to_mongo(mongo_log) ELSE log_to_postgres(log_data) — TWO DIFFERENT payloads: the mongo-shaped doc vs the postgres-shaped row; the unconfigured path NEVER touches mongo

safe_decode_body_rule: None -> None; b'' -> None (EMPTY check is == b'', so bytearray(b'') does NOT match — port as-is); startswith 89 50 4E 47 / FF D8 FF / 25 50 44 46 -> '[Binary Content]' (only PREFIX checked); else utf-8 decode, UnicodeDecodeError -> '[Could not decode content]' (other decode errors, e.g. ValueError from non-bytes input, propagate — port as-is)
